scope: Read-only research for PRD R10/R11; not implementation or real-data activation approval

confirmed.fact: Host/Origin/JSON restrictions exist. An adapter using the configured local host and omitting Origin is not inherently blocked; retain these checks rather than bypassing them.
Existing OMP polling feeds complete scanned inputs into ingestion; it is not a safe new-only activation mechanism.
related() is an internal candidate-based lookup over document rows. It is not a user-query recall endpoint and project attribute is one OR condition, not strict project authorization.
Mental edits, proposal acceptance, and undo exist. There is no automatic chat recall endpoint.
An existing global Hindsight gate supports optional agent_end capture; default mode is A. This source default is not proof of effective runtime environment.
Existing user-owned project configuration contains task role bindings; preserve them during any approved project-specific memory cutover.

searchProbe.limits: Three read-only queries, not a recall-quality or latency benchmark. No new note, cloud call, or production access was performed.
searchProbe.pathContract: parseSearchBlockRequest splits each paths item into notebook ID and internal document path. Returned path contains node IDs and .sy; it is not the human hPath. Never pass a human rootPath as an independent paths item. Strict destination/project/operation validation is still required after search.

decisions: Use a generic adapter capture/recall boundary and an OMP extension; do not patch OMP core or emulate the entire Hindsight API.
Use durable incremental capture identity and acknowledgement. Do not enable the existing whole-directory poller against private history for the new-only rollout.
Read current authorized SiYuan content for recall; derive withdrawn eligibility from operation states rather than inventing an independently maintained candidate status.
A manually edited owned note must not be replaced by stale generated text. Old mental claims dependent on changed or withdrawn source content must be omitted.
Do not claim vector/semantic retrieval from full-text query probes.
Project memory ownership must be explicit; no parallel automatic Hindsight and SiYuan capture/recall in the same enabled project. Unrelated projects remain unchanged.
